records.jp: ……。決まらないわね
records.en_original: ...We're not gonna figure this out, are we?
records.en_auxiliary: ...We're not gonna figure this out, are we?
records.en: ...We're not gonna figure this out, are we?

records.jp: 全員が参加できて、火やお金の管理もいらないもの……
records.en_original: We need something everyone can participate in that doesn't involve fire or handling money...
records.en_auxiliary: We need something everyone can participate in that doesn't involve fire or handling money...
records.en: We need something everyone can participate in that doesn't involve fire or handling money...

records.jp: あと、私たちの強みを活かせるものがいいわよね。<CR>特待科の人も普通科の人もみんなで活躍できるもの
records.en_original: It should be something that showcases our strenghts, don't you think? Across both the special and regular programs.
records.en_auxiliary: It should also be something that showcases our strengths, don't you think? Across both the special and regular classes.
records.en: And it should be something that makes use of our strengths.<CR>Something where everyone in both the Special Class and Regular Class can shine.

records.jp: んー、ステージでマッスルミュージアムとか……？
records.en_original: Hmm... How about an onstage Muscle Museum...?
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... How about something like an onstage muscle competition?
records.en: Hmm... How about an onstage Muscle Museum...?

records.jp: （それは……ちょっと）
records.en_original: (Did she say..."Muscle Museum"?)
records.en_auxiliary: (I don't think that's going to fly...)
records.en: (That's...a little much.)

records.jp: ステージ……ねえ、演劇なんてどうかしら？
records.en_original: Salvaging what we can from that... If we're going to do something on a stage, How about a play?
records.en_auxiliary: Salvaging what we can from that... If we're going to do something on a stage, how about a play?
records.en: A stage... Hey, how about putting on a play?

records.jp: 演劇かー
records.en_original: How did nobody think of that before?
records.en_auxiliary: A play, huh?
records.en: A play, huh?

records.jp: いいんじゃない？　役割分担もしやすいし
records.en_original: Sounds good to me! It'll be easy to give everyone parts too.
records.en_auxiliary: Sounds good to me! It'll be easy to give everyone parts, too.
records.en: Sounds good. It'd be easy to divide up the roles, too.

records.jp: 賛成！
records.en_original: For sure!
records.en_auxiliary: For sure!
records.en: For sure!

records.jp: なら、賛成多数ってことで演劇にしましょう
records.en_original: Well, if the majority's in favor, a play it is.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, if the majority's in favor, a play it is.
records.en: Well, if the majority's in favor, a play it is.

records.jp: じゃあ、次は何の演目にするかを決めましょう
records.en_original: Now we need to decide which play to perform.
records.en_auxiliary: Now we need to decide which play to perform.
records.en: Now we need to decide which play to perform.

records.jp: 『シンデレラ』なんてどう？
records.en_original: How about "Cinderella?"
records.en_auxiliary: How about "Cinderella?"
records.en: How about "Cinderella?"

records.jp: さすがに子供向け過ぎない？
records.en_original: Isn't that kinda childish?
records.en_auxiliary: Isn't that kinda childish?
records.en: Isn't that kinda childish?

records.jp: えー、そうかなー？
records.en_original: Huh? You think so?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? You think so?
records.en: Huh? You think so?

records.jp: でも、みんなが知ってる題材っていうのはいいんじゃない？
records.en_original: I'm all for it. I think it's good to do a story everybody knows.
records.en_auxiliary: I do think it's a good idea to do a story everybody knows, though.
records.en: Still, isn't it a good thing if everyone knows the story?

records.jp: じゃあ、大河やろうよ大河！
records.en_original: Let's do a historical saga!
records.en_auxiliary: Let's do a historical saga!
records.en: Then let's do a historical epic! A historical epic!

records.jp: えーっ、もっとロマンスっぽいのがいいなー
records.en_original: No, I want something that's more romantic!
records.en_auxiliary: No, I want something that's more romantic!
records.en: No, I want something that's more romantic!

records.jp: うーん、けど他にみんなが共通して知ってそうな演目ってあるか？
records.en_original: Hmm, okay then... I agree that we should do something well-known.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm, okay then... But is there anything else that everyone would know?
records.en: Hmm, but is there another play everyone would probably know?

records.jp: しかもそこそこ大人っぽいものね。<CR>何がいいかしら……？
records.en_original: But it can't be too childish either. What would work...?
records.en_auxiliary: Plus, it can't be too childish either. What would work...?
records.en: And something reasonably mature.<CR>What would be good...?

records.jp: ……『人魚姫』なんてどう？
records.en_original: ...How about "The Little Mermaid"?
records.en_auxiliary: ...How about "The Little Mermaid"?
records.en: ...How about "The Little Mermaid"?

records.jp: 童話かー。<CR>子供向けなのはシンデレラと同じだけど
records.en_original: Another fairytale? Isn't it just as kiddy as Cinderella?
records.en_auxiliary: Another fairytale? Isn't it just as kiddy as Cinderella?
records.en: A fairy tale, huh?<CR>It's just as much for children as Cinderella, though.

records.jp: どんな内容だっけ？
records.en_original: How's that story go again?
records.en_auxiliary: How's that story go again?
records.en: How's that story go again?

records.jp: ある日、人魚姫が人間の王子を救い出すんだけど、<CR>その王子様に恋をしてしまうの
records.en_original: One day, the little mermaid saves a human prince, and she falls in love with him.
records.en_auxiliary: One day, the little mermaid saves a human prince, and she falls in love with him.
records.en: One day, the little mermaid saves a human prince,<CR>and she falls in love with him.

records.jp: 人魚姫は王子様に会いに行くために、<CR>自分の声と引き換えに人間の足を手に入れる
records.en_original: In order to go meet the prince again, she exchanges her voice for human legs.
records.en_auxiliary: In order to go meet the prince again, she exchanges her voice for human legs.
records.en: To go and meet the prince, the little mermaid trades her voice<CR>for a pair of human legs.

records.jp: だけど、王子様は姫が命の恩人とは気づかず<CR>別の人と結婚してしまい、最後に姫は願いの代償で泡になる
records.en_original: But the prince never recognizes that it's her and marries someone else. The poor mermaid then dissolves into foam.
records.en_auxiliary: But the prince never recognizes that it's her and marries someone else. The poor mermaid then dissolves into foam.
records.en: But the prince doesn't realize that the princess is the one who saved his life<CR>and marries someone else. In the end, she turns into sea foam as the price of her wish.

records.jp: ざっくりまとめるとこんな感じかな
records.en_original: That's the general gist.
records.en_auxiliary: That's the general gist.
records.en: That's the general gist.

records.jp: へえ、悲劇かー
records.en_original: Whoa, I never knew it was a tragedy...
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa, I never knew it was a tragedy...
records.en: Oh, so it's a tragedy.

records.jp: でもいいんじゃない？　もとは童話なんだし<CR>あんまりドロドロしなさそうで
records.en_original: But that's what we're looking for, isn't it? It's a fairytale, but it's not overly childish.
records.en_auxiliary: But that's what we're looking for, isn't it? It's a fairytale, but it's not overly childish.
records.en: But isn't that fine? It started as a fairy tale,<CR>so it probably won't get too melodramatic.

records.jp: その話って……
records.en_original: It's...quite the story, Hinako...
records.en_auxiliary: It's...quite the story...
records.en: That story...

records.jp: （けど、なんか今の私に似てるかも……）
records.en_original: (It kind of sounds like me...)
records.en_auxiliary: (It kind of sounds like me...)
records.en: (It kind of sounds like me...)

records.jp: （人魚姫は王子に憧れていたんじゃなくて、人間のように陸を<CR>自由に歩けることを望んでいたのかも……）
records.en_original: (Maybe the mermaid longed to walk freely upon the land like a human more than she wanted to be with the prince...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Maybe the mermaid longed to walk freely upon the land like a human more than she wanted to be with the prince...)
records.en: (Maybe the little mermaid wasn't longing for the prince at all.<CR>Maybe she wished to walk freely on land like a human...)

records.jp: それなら、主役は日菜子ちゃんがいいんじゃないかなー
records.en_original: In that case, I think Hinako should be have the lead role!
records.en_auxiliary: In that case, I think Hinako should play the lead role!
records.en: In that case, shouldn't Hinako-chan play the lead?

records.jp: え？　私？
records.en_original: Huh? Why me?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? Why me?
records.en: Huh? Me?

records.jp: いいんじゃないか？　白井が実行委員なわけだし
records.en_original: Why not? You're on the committee, and you DID come up with the idea.
records.en_auxiliary: Why not? You're on the committee, and you DID come up with the idea.
records.en: Why not? Shirai's on the organizing committee, after all.

records.jp: でも……私、主役なんて
records.en_original: But...me? The lead?
records.en_auxiliary: But...me? The lead?
records.en: But...me? The lead?

records.jp: 大丈夫だって！　日菜子ちゃん、舞台映えすると思うし
records.en_original: It'll be fine! I'm sure you'll look great on stage!
records.en_auxiliary: It'll be fine! I'm sure you'll look great on stage!
records.en: It'll be fine! I'm sure you'll look great on stage, Hinako-chan!

records.jp: 決まり決まり！
records.en_original: Then it's settled!
records.en_auxiliary: Then it's settled!
records.en: Then it's settled!

records.jp: まあ、みんながそう言うなら……
records.en_original: Well, I guess if you all say so...
records.en_auxiliary: Well, I guess if you all say so...
records.en: Well, I guess if you all say so...

records.jp: じゃあ一度脚本を持ってきて、読み合わせしてみようよ！
records.en_original: Once we have a script, we can start practicing!
records.en_auxiliary: Once we have a script, we can start practicing!
records.en: Then let's get a script and try doing a read-through!

records.jp: はぁ。やっと本格的に動けそうね
records.en_original: *sigh* I'm just glad the ball's rolling.
records.en_auxiliary: *Sigh* I'm just glad the ball's rolling.
records.en: *sigh* I'm just glad the ball's rolling.

records.jp: ……まずは脚本の方向性を考えましょう。<CR>どんな感じの舞台にするか考えないと
records.en_original: ...Before we do anything else, let's figure our direction for the play.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Before we do anything else, let's figure our direction for the play.
records.en: ...First, let's decide on the direction of the script.<CR>We need to figure out what kind of production we want.

records.jp: 亜子ちゃんたちにもお願いしようよ！　たしか放送部って、<CR>自分たちでラジオドラマとか朗読劇の脚本を書いてたよね？
records.en_original: Let's ask Ako for help! Doesn't the broadcast club write scripts for features and radio plays and stuff?
records.en_auxiliary: Let's ask Ako for help! Doesn't the broadcast club write scripts for features and radio plays and stuff?
records.en: Let's ask Ako-chan and the others! The broadcast club writes scripts for its radio dramas<CR>and dramatic readings, right?

records.jp: そういえば！　最近もコンクールで賞を取ってた気がするし、<CR>力になってくれそうじゃない？
records.en_original: Now that you mention it, I heard one of their scripts won an award in a recent competition, so they might be a help!
records.en_auxiliary: Now that you mention it, I heard one of their scripts won an award in a recent competition, so they might be of help!
records.en: Come to think of it! I think they won an award in a competition recently,<CR>so don't you think they could help?

records.jp: じゃあ呼んでくる！
records.en_original: I'll go call them!
records.en_auxiliary: I'll go call them!
records.en: I'll go call them!

records.jp: そうね。お願い
records.en_original: Great. I'll let you take care of that, then.
records.en_auxiliary: Great. I'll let you take care of that, then.
records.en: All right. Please do.

records.jp: 任せといて！
records.en_original: I got this!
records.en_auxiliary: I got this!
records.en: I got this!

records.jp: それじゃあ、先に今いるメンバーで決められるところを<CR>決めておきましょうか
records.en_original: Well then, I guess we should try and figure out a few more things for the time being.
records.en_auxiliary: Well then, I guess we should try and figure out a few more things for the time being.
records.en: Then let's decide whatever we can<CR>with the members who are here first.

records.jp: 私は遠慮する
records.en_original: I decline.
records.en_auxiliary: I decline.
records.en: I decline.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: この後、少し用があるのでね。<CR>演目の方針が決まったのならこれで失礼させていただく
records.en_original: I have business to take care of. Now that we've decided on the direction of the play, please excuse me.
records.en_auxiliary: I have business to take care of. Now that we've decided on the<CR>direction of the play, please excuse me.
records.en: I have something to do after this.<CR>Now that the direction of the production has been decided, I'll take my leave.

records.jp: では、ごきげんよう
records.en_original: Good-bye for now.
records.en_auxiliary: Goodbye for now.
records.en: Good-bye for now.

records.jp: 今の子……
records.en_original: That girl just now...
records.en_auxiliary: That girl just now...
records.en: That girl just now...

records.jp: 斎木有理ちゃんだよ
records.en_original: That's Yuri Saiki.
records.en_auxiliary: That's Yuri Saiki.
records.en: That's Saiki Yuri-chan.

records.jp: 知ってるの？
records.en_original: You know her?
records.en_auxiliary: You know her?
records.en: You know her?

records.jp: 有名人だからね。<CR>中間試験は全教科満点でもちろん学年順位はトップ
records.en_original: She's famous. She got perfect scores in in all subjects on our midterms, so she's the clear head of the class.
records.en_auxiliary: She's famous. She got perfect scores in all subjects on our midterms, so she's the clear top of the class.
records.en: She's famous.<CR>She got perfect scores in every subject on the midterms and, of course, ranked first in our year.

records.jp: ＩＱ３００の天才って話だよね
records.en_original: I've heard that she has an IQ of 300.
records.en_auxiliary: I've heard that she has an IQ of 300.
records.en: I've heard that she has an IQ of 300.

records.jp: さ、さんびゃく！？　そんな数字ありえるの？
records.en_original: Th-Three hundred!? Is that even possible?
records.en_auxiliary: Th-three hundred!? Is that even possible?
records.en: Th-Three hundred!? Is that even possible?

records.jp: さあ？　実際にそう言われてるってことはありえるんじゃない？
records.en_original: Who knows? But if anyone's that smart, it's gotta be her.
records.en_auxiliary: Who knows? But I guess so since people say that about her.
records.en: Who knows? If that's what people say, I suppose it must be possible.

records.jp: はぁあ……
records.en_original: Whoa...
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa...
records.en: Whoa...
